entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I bought some mountain bike shoes a while ago, and I really need to return them. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

I've tried them on a few rides, and they just don't feel right. No matter how I adjust them, I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal customer for years... and I really needed this money. It's just a shame they didn't work out.

Oh, that sounds very uncomfortable. Getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like a sizing or fit issue rather than a problem with the cleats or a technical fault, is that correct?
Yes, exactly. They just hurt my feet. I was hoping I could still get a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy to confirm the eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 57 days ago. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window for a return.
Oh, really? That's... such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I'm processing the return now and I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Please pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Diana. You've really made my day.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
